passive.kind: flat two-pin knee closing the loop at the cuff (pins a, b parallel to J3; NO encoders - pose from the 3 hub encoders, user 2026-10-17); set by loop closure. K (4th revolute) is NOT a DOF: slaved to q2 by the roller-flank drive past the onset, spring-held on stop A below it; the bell crank is set by the law phi = |dK| / g

O20 x 12.25 v5 hub, MR117-2RS pair, encoder

drive.kind: slipper-nose: hub-2 rim lobe -> bell crank on link 1b (MR63ZZ pair on an O3 pin; follower on the short arm s_arm, bent long arm to r_c about hub K) -> pressed ISO 8734 O2.5 m6 440C dowel, nose ground O2.368 -> SLIDES (mu 0.087, a-C:H DLC, greased) on the conjugate spherical flank wire-EDM'd into link 1a's lateral boss (5-axis / tilting-head wire-EDM); one clock spring on K force-closes both rolling pairs; no rod, no ball links
components: ISO 8734 O3 m6 pin pressed H7/m6 in link 1b + DIN 6799 RS 2.3
ISO 8734 O2.5 x 6 m6 440C nose dowel (nose ground O2.368 g5)

lobe.note: inside hub 2's O20 skirt over the whole stroke (r <= HUB_R): the follower (the crank's short arm s_arm, at the boss's hub-side flank) that rides it reaches through a window in hub 2's cap ring - an L2 detail; the verified model samples neither the lobe nor the follower

stack_fix.why: the model stacks the boss on its 6 link-1b strap samples nearest the pivot; the built boss + the arm root sit on the strap's highest top under the O10 footprint + 0.15 (raised only if the strap climbs there); the arm keeps the model's levels from there, the nose / flank (the cam) are unchanged

slaved.law: dK = kK (q2 - q2hi) along the stretching sense (lin), cut at the drive's own range dK_lim

knuckle.note: az/el/a/w = the 3R with K on stop A; past the onset q2hi K is SLAVED to q2 by the slipper-nose drive (lobe -> bell crank -> sliding dowel nose -> conjugate flank on link 1a; 3 active DOF; K never free, never read); the bell crank (dk) is a posed side member of link 1b

base.note: base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler, carried directly at the J1 hub ring (no tab)
